candidate.definition_en: To begin to do or pursue something again after a pause or interruption.
candidate.explanation_ar: يستأنف أو يكمل حاجة بعد ما وقف شوية. زي لما تكمل الفيلم بعد الفاصل.

senses.definition_en: To begin to do or pursue something again after a pause or interruption.
senses.definition_ar: يستأنف أو يواصل بعد توقف مؤقت
examples: We will resume the discussion after a brief break.
The talks are scheduled to resume tomorrow morning.
Both sides agreed to resume diplomatic relations next month.
